notes.title: 7 Languages Added!
notes.content:
Max Manos now supports 7 new languages! You can now play the game in:

🇩🇪 German
🇫🇷 French
🇪🇸 Spanish
🇵🇱 Polish (thanks to Jakub "Linshi" Plichta)
🇳🇱 Dutch
🇧🇷 Brazilian Portuguese
🇨🇳 Simplified Chinese

Cheers,
Max Manos
